# OmniTool Hub

> OmniTool Hub is a high-performance, privacy-first, client-side utility suite featuring 50+ developer, cryptography, data processing, and document utilities running 100% in-browser with zero server uploads.

## Core Information & Sitemap

- [Home & Tool Hub](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/): Instant access to all client-side tools and utilities.
- [Sitemap](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable XML sitemap of all active routes and tool suites.
- [AI Catalog (ARD)](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable Agent Resource Discovery catalog for AI agents and WebMCP.
- [Tool Documentation & Guides](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/guides/): Comprehensive offline tutorials, usage guides, and data flow specifications.
- [Privacy Architecture](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/about): Complete technical overview of OmniTool Hub's sandboxed client-side processing.

## Developer & Data Pipeline Tools

- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/json-formatter): Format, validate, lint, minify, and inspect JSON documents offline.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/base64): Encode and decode UTF-8 text, binary files, and data URIs client-side.
- [JWT Token Debugger](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/jwt-debugger): Decode, inspect header/claims, and verify HMAC SHA-256 signatures securely without network calls.
- [Regex Tester & Explainer](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/regex-tester): Interactive Regular Expression testing engine with real-time match highlighting and flag toggles.
- [Hash Generator](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/hash-generator): Compute cryptographic MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes using native Web Crypto API.
- [UUID & GUID Generator](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/uuid-generator): Cryptographically secure RFC4122 v4 and timestamp-based v7 UUID generation in bulk.
- [Markdown Live Editor](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/markdown-preview): Real-time GitHub-flavored markdown editor, HTML exporter, and word counter.
- [URL Encoder / Decoder](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/url-encoder): Encode and decode query strings, full URI components, and special characters.
- [CSS Minifier](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/css-minifier): Clean, minify, and remove duplicate whitespace from CSS stylesheets.
- [HTML Entity Encoder](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/html-encoder): Convert characters to HTML entities and decode special characters.

## Productivity & Utility Tools

- [Color Studio & Converter](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/color-converter): Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK with harmonic palette generation.
- [Unit Converter](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/unit-converter): Multi-dimensional unit conversions across length, weight, temperature, data size, and time.
- [Smart Calculator](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/calculator): Scientific calculation suite with history and keyboard-first workflow.
- [Text Difference Checker](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/diff-checker): Visual side-by-side line and character diff comparison.
- [QR Code Studio](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/qr-generator): Generate customizable SVG/PNG QR codes with instant local download.
- [Smart Password Generator](https://omnitool.worldsneed.com/tool/password-generator): Entropy-driven client-side password and passphrase generator.
